requiredBehaviors.behavior: treat the prior not-reportable and complaint-closure states as historical to their earlier evidence snapshot
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill makes prior vigilance and complaint closure states historical to their Evidence Snapshot rather than permanent barriers to new assessment.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: repeat current-source vigilance assessment when the new material facts may affect serious-incident reportability or field-action evaluation
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The reassessment workflow re-runs current-source vigilance when new seriousness, false-result, malfunction, FSCA or market facts may materially affect reportability.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve the earlier decision version and route the new state back to PMS risk CAPA PMPF or performance owners as applicable
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Prior Decision Reference and Decision Version remain explicit while the new state is routed to PMS and the applicable lifecycle owners.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: reuse the earlier not-reportable result without assessing the new evidence
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: A prior not-reportable-on-current-evidence state cannot be carried forward unchanged across a material Evidence Delta.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: overwrite the earlier vigilance decision or treat prior complaint closure as regulatory closure
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Reassessment is versioned and complaint closure remains separate from regulatory closure.
